notes.title: Game Update - April 20, 2025
notes.content: Since the game's theme is a story of "ants defeating elephants," the initial design overly emphasized this core concept, resulting in excessively high enemy difficulty and neglecting the average player's experience. Based on widespread feedback from game critics, this update significantly reduces all enemy attribute values and boosts the player's initial stats. The current version still offers a challenging experience, with the key to victory lying in collecting all hidden runes and mastering skill timing. Enjoy the game!
